messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx egress errors observed from ca-central1 (mtl1) gateways to several upstream peers. Error rate: 18% over 2m. Paging on-call.

sarah (oncall): I'm looking. Confirming scope — which pools are impacted?

mike (sre): seeing spike on gw-ca-mtl-0[1-3]. NAT table near capacity, tail latencies up, some connections reset. Logs below:

```
May 04 14:02:34 gw-ca-mtl-01 kernel: conntrack: table full, dropping conn
2026-05-04T14:03:10Z http: upstream connection reset by peer -> 502
```

kevin (eng-runtime): can we reroute egress to us-east1 temporarily? BGP policies allow pref override for ca-central1 -> us-east1 via transit-2.

sarah (oncall): rolling a quick mitigation: (1) reduce new ephemeral allocation on gw-ca-mtl-* to relieve NAT pressure (2) announce more-specific route to prefer us-east1 for external egress of non-local tenants. Doing step 1 now.

l3-oncall: heading in to assist on the BGP work. I can make the announcement once we confirm temporary policy. Tag me when you want me to flip.

sarah (oncall): step 1 done: lowered ephemeral pool from 1024->512 on gw-ca-mtl-*. Observed small drop in conntrack pressure. Still seeing 10-12% errors. Preparing step 2.

kevin (eng-runtime): recommended exact BGP command (for netops):

```
# announce more-specific /24 on transit-2 for ca-customer-egress
bgp> neighbor 10.1.2.5 route-map PREFER-USE-EAST out
route-map PREFER-USE-EAST permit 10
 set local-preference 200
```

mike (sre): NetOps, stand by to apply at :10-CRT:. We should also set automatic fallback rule to revert pref after 45m.

jamie (prod comms): Drafting status page + customer notice. Proposed status page text: \"Partial degradation: Customers routing through Canada (ca-central1) may see increased request errors and retries. We are actively rerouting traffic and expect mitigation within ~45 minutes. No data loss.\" Can someone confirm ETA?

sarah (oncall): ETA 30-60m depending on propagation. I'll mark 45m now.

statuspage-bot: STATUSPAGE DRAFT: region: ca-central1 -> Partial Degradation. Impact: Increased 5xx errors for affected endpoints. Start: 2026-05-04T14:02Z. Update: Mitigation in progress.

jamie (prod comms): customer email draft: 

"Hi — We're investigating elevated error rates affecting requests from Canadian endpoints (ca-central1). We've begun rerouting traffic to alternate regions and expect improved service within 45 minutes. We'll post updates to status.redwood.ai. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Inference Trust & Ops"

sarah (oncall): approve the message. Post to status page once we flip BGP. Tag me for tweet if needed.

l3-oncall: applying BGP pref now. Will monitor for route convergence.

(2 minutes later)

l3-oncall: BGP pref applied on transit-2. Verified more-specifics announced.

mike (sre): traffic shifting. observing drop in egress error rate to 4% after a few mins. Latency stable.

sarah (oncall): statuspage-bot, publish the draft now and mark visible to all customers.

statuspage-bot: Published: Partial Degradation - ca-central1. Message: "We are actively rerouting traffic to alternate regions (US) to mitigate increased egress errors. Service may be degraded for some customers."
Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1972468000

jamie (prod comms): will send targeted notify to customers with >1M tokens/day and regs teams (CAN/FIN compliance) in parallel. Using template: short summary + link + recommend no config changes.

kevin (eng-runtime): quick checklist for rollback once resolved:
- remove route-map PREFER-USE-EAST on transit-2
- restore ephemeral pool limits
- monitor conntrack to baseline for 10m
- postmortem owner: ops-sre

mike (sre): monitoring. If errors stay <5% for 10m, we can start rolling back route pref.

(30 minutes later)

mike (sre): holding steady at 2-3% errors. conntrack usage returned to normal.

sarah (oncall): initiating rollback of BGP pref in 2m. Notifying NetOps.

l3-oncall: removed route-map from transit-2. Propagation underway.

mike (sre): observed errors remain low after rollback. All gw-ca-mtl-* metrics look normal.

sarah (oncall): taking incident to resolved in status page now. Notifying postmortem owner.

statuspage-bot: Updated: Incident resolved. Impact: Partial degradation in ca-central1 mitigated by reroute and configuration changes. Full service restored at 2026-05-04T14:58Z.

jamie (prod comms): Sent follow-up customer update: \"Root cause under investigation, mitigation completed, full restoration confirmed. We will send a detailed postmortem within 48 hours.\"

sarah (oncall): Assigning postmortem to mike (sre). Please include timeline, root cause (conntrack saturation + NAT sizing), mitigation steps, and longterm fix (increase conntrack reserve + alerting on NAT saturation).

mike (sre): ACK. Drafting postmortem and will ping for review.

sarah (oncall): Thanks all. Close the loop in #eng-oncall and add runbook note for ca-central1 NAT thresholds. :white_check_mark:

end of thread
